newsitem.title: COTE D'IVOIRE: PRESS DIGEST - Ivory Coast - Feb 13.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Ivory Coast - Feb 13.

text.p: These are significant items in the Ivorian press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these items and does not vouch for their accuracy. FRATERNITE MATIN - Ivorian government names nine members of privatisation committee for two-year terms. Jean-Claude Brou remains president. - Ivorian government gives U.S. armed forces permission to use Abidjan airbase as transit point for airlift of extra West African peacekeepers to Liberia, where elections are envisaged in May under a peace plan. - Education Minister Saliou Toure says government has no immediate plan to declare academic year in universities forfait despite student unrest and strike calls; says government has no immediate plans to privatise universities. LA VOIE - University lecture halls remain empty on day two of five-day student strike; security forces deployed on campus. LE JOUR - Ivory Coast's main port in Abidjan, the commercial capital, is to computerise its operations; delegation from French port of Marseille pushes for contract which is due to go out to tender; port director says offers likely to be considered in March - Ivory Coast to organise an agricultural show from November 27 to December 7
